website.headline: It starts from what you already have.
website.lead: Your website, your store, your past conversations. You confirm, GOTCHA reads.
website.foot: Nothing reaches a customer until you say so
website.title: Is this your website?

from.scan: GOTCHA read it before. Reading it again brings it up to date

website.askLead: GOTCHA reads it to learn how your business works. Nothing is read until you say so
website.notReadYet: Not read yet. What it finds shows on the next step
website.notAnAddress: That doesn't look like a website address. Try something like yourbusiness.com
website.noWebsite: No website? Start from something else
website.elsewhereWhy: Starting from these isn't available yet. For now GOTCHA starts from a website
website.consent: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>

reading.headline: It reads your website so you don't have to explain it.

lead.reading: About two minutes. You can watch, or go make coffee
lead.failed: It couldn't finish reading the site. You can try again, or try another address
lead.notStarted: The read hasn't started. Try again from your website

reading.foot: You can close this tab, it keeps going
reading.title: Reading <host></host>
reading.factsSoon: Facts appear here as pages are turned into knowledge
reading.nothingWritten: Nothing was added to Knowledge from this read
reading.missed: Couldn't check just now. Trying again

learned.headline: What it knows, and how it will sound.
learned.lead: Approve once. Everything here lands in Knowledge, where you can change it any time.
learned.foot: Nothing reaches a customer until you say so
learned.title: What GOTCHA knows now
learned.count: {facts, plural, =1 {1 fact from your website} other {# facts from your website}}
learned.countFromPages: {facts, plural, =1 {1 fact} other {# facts}} from {pages, plural, =1 {1 page} other {# pages}}
learned.none: Nothing from your website is in Knowledge yet
learned.whereToChange: It's all in Knowledge already, and you can change any of it there. <knowledge>Open Knowledge</knowledge>
learned.conflictsWhy: Pages that say different things aren't checked against each other yet. If two pages disagree, fix the page, and GOTCHA learns again.

voice.title: How you sound
voice.unread: Couldn't read the voice just now.
voice.scaleWhy: A formal to casual setting isn't available yet. Describe it in the voice below
voice.placeholder: Warm and short. First names, no emoji, never "Dear customer"
voice.sampleAsk: Ask for a reply to hear it
voice.sampleNeedsVoice: Describe the voice first, then ask for a reply
voice.sampleUnavailable: Replies can't be written just now. Try again in a moment
voice.sampleFailed: Couldn't write a reply just now
voice.ask: Write a reply in this voice
voice.saveFailed: The voice wasn't saved. Try again

truth.headline: The most important connection you'll make.
truth.lead: Your website explains how things work. Your store knows what's true right now. GOTCHA checks it before every answer about an order, a price or stock.
truth.foot: You decide what it may change. Reading is always safe

try.headline: Judge it on your own questions.
try.lead: Things your customers really asked. If an answer is off, fix it once and it's fixed everywhere.
try.foot: Setup mode: it only talks to your team until you go live
